searchText: <CarlBeek> Happy to do so, but it will probably take me a day or two, I’m slammed at the moment Thanks. Reminder, RollCall #2 in 20 mins! Join Zoom Meeting https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/82673576599?pwd=5eM5d0bqTKZvCeXIWEAmMc8Hk6zm2k.1 Meeting ID: 826 7357 6599 Passcode: 576777 <CarlBeek> Call now <maintainereth> EOF Implementers Call now Hi <@550420431744794624>! My team at Forta Network, along with OpenZeppelin, have developed a new precompile we are considering submitting as an RIP. Is there a separate RIP submission and review process independent from the EIP process documented at https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1? "The RIPs repository is in the startup phase, and so is undergoing many changes. This document is very much a work in progress. Both the process and how RIPs will be written and governed is still being worked on. Feedback encouraged on Ethereum Magicians." From RIP7559: https://github.com/ethereum/RIPs/blob/e0ce6e9614d5bf152df9f34aee361b2456b3c752/RIPS/rip-7559.md Thanks for sharing <@365300888354422794>. Since RIPs are optional, is this RIP process then intended to largely be a *shared* forum and public comment period for new features being considered by one or more rollups? I'm assuming any proposed feature would need to go through the governance process for each rollup after it goes through the RIP process.
